model_output.summary: Added a Descent interactable at node `descent` and an end-of-demo state. Before the toll is paid, E on the descent shows "The bandit boss bars the way down. Pay his toll first." and the demo continues. After the toll is paid, E sets `bDemoOver`, adds a win message and disables pawn input. `HandleInteract` ignores all interaction once the demo is over, and the HUD draws a persistent "YOU WIN" banner. The barred and win texts are labeled demo text because bandit_strings.csv has no suitable string.
model_output.connection: `ADDDemoDirector::BeginPlay` (spawned by the demo level) calls `SpawnInteractable(EDDDemoKind::Descent, ...)` at `NodeLocation("descent")`. The player's E key calls `ADDDemoCharacter::Interact`, then `ADDDemoInteractable::Interact`, then `ADDDemoDirector::HandleInteract`, which handles the new Descent case. `ADDDemoDirector::PromptFor` supplies the prompt. `ADDDemoHUD::DrawHUD` finds the director and draws the banner when `IsDemoOver()` is true.
